sources.scope: The Villas - Shoreditch AndSoul (apartment building, 114 Cheshire St)
highlights: Amazing experience and the staff really helpful.
Food by Palm Greens is good.
And it's not just about variety—the quality is top-notch.

reviews.author: Benjamin Mitchell
reviews.text: Such a unique and exciting space! The sauna is like nothing I've ever seen before, such amazing design. I've attended a number of classes and workshops in the sauna and the yoga space. Some really cool live events. Met some really lovely friendly people there too.

reviews.author: Muhammad Ashfaq
reviews.text: I was living at Chapters Spitalfields, and Youcef was there as night security, and he worked really well and performed his duty very well — so much satisfied with the night security team.

reviews.author: Heloisa Ferrage
reviews.text: I had such an incredible experience during a sauna session with Big Sun. Her calm, soothing voice, the serene music and peaceful atmosphere made the whole session pure relaxation. I would love to come back for another session, highly recommend!

sources.note: Only the 3 reviews Google shows before 'More reviews' are captured (dates are approximate, 'a year ago' / 'a month ago'). Most reviews on this listing are about the Sanctuary sauna and classes rather than the villas themselves — the listing predates the residential opening.
